definitions.gloss: person who founded a company or business
definitions.explanation: The person who started or established a company, shop, or organization. Formed from 創業 (founding a business) and 者 (person). Often used when referring to the original founder by name or legacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}。
{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}ぐ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧。
examples.english: To carry on the founder's spirit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創業者|そうぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さかのぼる⟦{家系|かけい}→家系：10130_kakei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だそうだ。
examples.english: I hear that the founder of this long-established shop comes from a lineage going back to the Edo period.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧ (founding a business) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Refers specifically to the person who started a business, not just any executive.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧: founding a business; starting a company
- {設立者|せつりつしゃ}: founder (legal sense, person who formally established an organization)
- ⟦{起業家|きぎょうか}→起業家：14262_kigyouka⟧: entrepreneur (broader term)
- ⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧: business owner; manager (current operator, may not be the original founder)
